service.description: Marks a tenant's config pending after a save that changed it committed (called async by TenantConfigChangeTracker, once per tenant per transaction).

parameter.name: userId
parameter.description: Who saved; the version is credited to whoever saved last.

service.description: Keeps a config version for each pending tenant that has been quiet for quietSeconds, oldest first, up to maxTenants per run; each tenant in its own transaction. A tenant whose version fails keeps its row, with the reason, and is tried again after 15 minutes.

parameter.name: nowStamp
parameter.description: The moment to judge "quiet" at; pinned by tests, now otherwise.

parameter.name: outcomes
parameter.description: [{tenant, outcome: VERSIONED | UNCHANGED | NOT_QUIET | BACKING_OFF | FAILED, versionId, error}]
